Summary

Samsung detailed its September 2026 security patch, addressing 90 total vulnerabilities across Google Android components, semiconductor hardware, and custom Galaxy software. The rollout began unexpectedly through a One UI 9 beta update for the Galaxy A55 before reaching regular consumer builds. [...] Samsung is officially rolling out its September 2026 security update for Galaxy smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches. However, the delivery strategy looks a bit different this time around. Instead of kicking off the monthly update with a standard public patch for its top-tier flagships, Samsung packaged the September security fixes inside a One UI 9 beta build for the Galaxy A55.

results.content:
Samsung’s September 2026 security package fixes 58 vulnerabilities from the Android Security Bulletin. These include 18 critical and 40 high security flaws affecting the core operating system. The update also packs one security fix from Samsung Semiconductor for several Exynos products. It addresses a semiconductor vulnerability in the NAS message handler.
